args: mkdir -p /etc/dropbear; echo ssh-ed25519 AAAA realityhop >> x
cases.out:
#!/bin/sh
cd "$(dirname "$0")" || exit 1
printf "\033]0;Reality Hop: add key to router\007"
echo "Type the router admin password (the one for the GL.iNet web panel) and press Enter."
echo "Nothing shows while you type. Reality Hop never sees it."
echo
/usr/bin/ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=known_hosts root@192.168.8.1 'mkdir -p /etc/dropbear; echo ssh-ed25519 AAAA realityhop >> x'
echo
printf "Press Enter to close. "
read _
